recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. No further core source work is indicated for FHIR-13152 unless a future build process intentionally brings the legacy tools/ig sample pages into current publication scope.
issue_request: FHIR-13152 was Published/Persuasive for a non-substantive FHIR-I technical correction. The Jira reported inconsistent use of Bootstrap col-12 and col-9 wrappers across FHIR-core pages and requested that everything use col-12 if possible.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 12604. Git commit a6edf67ad6cf62cfcbc581dea7a330cb8e5c9181 carries that git-svn revision and changed 101 source/*.html pages from col-9 to col-12; commit 66f032b79d04b7e11e7b6c94408f6f6178f933d7 then made the same home page correction. Current source/ already had no col-9, but tools/html/search.cfm and tools/html/registry/index.html still had col-9 wrappers.
additional_context: publish.ini maps [html] source to tools/html, so the two static tooling pages are current publish inputs. A remaining col-9 under tools/ig/pages/_includes/header.html was not referenced by publish.ini, source/fhir.ini, or the current publish scripts checked here, so it was treated as a legacy IG sample/template rather than a current core-build defect. Jira search found no other col-9/col-12 tracker, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed tools/html/search.cfm and tools/html/registry/index.html from class="col-9" to class="col-12" so the copied static pages match the full-width layout already applied to source pages and current templates.
source_changes: tools/html/search.cfm: changed the static search page content wrapper from col-9 to col-12.
tools/html/registry/index.html: changed the static registry page content wrapper from col-9 to col-12.

related_jiras.note: A recent combined-branch commit touched tools/html/registry/index.html for a footer symbol, confirming the static registry page is active tooling-page source, but it did not address the col-9/col-12 layout issue.
